goodToKnow: Das Blaulicht is the blue flashing light of emergency vehicles, usually with das Martinshorn (siren): mit Blaulicht fahren. On German motorways, drivers must form a Rettungsgasse (emergency corridor) as soon as traffic slows, between the left lane and the others; failing to do so brings fines. Police, fire brigades and ambulances are called Blaulichtorganisationen. It has no plural.
